results.title: Backflip Crazy
results.overview: A comic book artist sets off on a research assignment with a martial arts master while her insecure boyfriend stomps around with jealousy and fragile masculinity. Things take a turn when he challenges the Sensei to perform a backflip. Things get a lil' backflip crazy...

results.title: Who Raised You
results.overview: Upon the death of her grandmother, Tia's party boy father inherits her family home. His surprise arrival blows up Tia's life, pushing her grief to a breaking point. With the help of her friend Layla, also grieving the woman who raised her, Tia is determined to run far away. Instead of the escape Tia intended, life offers the girls refuge in each other.

results.title: PR
results.overview: PR follows a middle-aged man in Hawaii who quietly trains for months to deadlift 300 pounds. To the gym-bros around him, his daily grind looks like vanity, ego, or some late attempt to impress women. But his real motivation remains private, as most true motivations do. Set against the ordinary rhythms of local life, PR uses time, repetition, and routine to let the everyday breathe. The film looks for a Hawaii hidden in plain sight; not the postcard fantasy, and not the weight of history, but the mundane spaces in between, where small acts of discipline and love can become their own kind of triumph.

results.title: Oli
results.overview: A Kānaka Maoli soldier returns to Hawaiʻi after losing a comrade in arms for which he blames himself. Suffering from PTSD and survivor"s guilt, Paʻakai attempts to adjust to being back on the ʻĀina. He struggles to connect with his mother, family, and friends from high school. Recognizing her son is troubled, Kaiʻs mother recommends oli (chanting) as a means to help. Can ancestral knowledge help Kai heal?

results.title: Massagers 4 Sale
results.overview: A young woman's relationship with her father reaches its crisis point when he mistakenly purchases a new line of 'massagers' and 'toys' for their Chinatown gift shop in danger of being closed down.

results.title: Dan & Kat Hide a Body
results.overview: Dan and Kat are social media influencers on a couples vacation to Venezuela. When they accidentally hit a woman with their car, their picture-perfect getaway takes a dark turn. Rather than face the consequences, they attempt to hide the body and cover up what happened. Dark hilarity ensues as they scramble to evade accountability from both the law and the internet, while desperately maintaining their carefully curated online personas.

results.title: Sensibilities of the Heart
results.overview: Two friends pour their hearts out over a tension-filled dinner.

results.title: Chloe Radcliffe: Eyes Down Here
results.overview: Chloe Radcliffe takes a hard look at flirting when you don't fit in. She analyzes staring (at her birthmark or other people's boobs), sitting in a stranger's shit, and why Doritos aren't made for women. A special dedicated to anyone who's ever felt overlooked at a party.

results.title: A Revolta dos Miseráveis
results.overview: The film revisits the history of the punk rock band Cama de Jornal, following their resistance to time and the challenges faced along a journey directly linked to the consolidation of the punk scene in the city of Vitória da Conquista.

results.title: Fig
results.overview: Swimming in the sea, silent meals, attempts to hold on to intimacy — this is how the couple spends the final days of their relationship at an old summer house on the Caspian shore. Years later, the man lives alone in the house he once built beside that same summer place. The fig tree and the sea remain the same. Simple tastes and moments remind that life goes on. And solitude can be a conscious choice.

results.title: High Frequency
results.overview: A young man is torn between his passion for the saxophone and figure skating, as his coach puts increasing pressure on him to become like the skater’s idol — Salvador.

results.title: BatFreak Part III: The Final Act
results.original_title: BatFreak Part III: The Final Act
results.overview: After a death in the family, BatFreak must cope with the loss of his son - while also battling a formidable new foe, The Auckland Knight. BatFreak and his new team of ragtag superheroes must destroy the rising threats or meet their untimely demise.

results.title: Yastay
results.overview: Two centuries after the historic crossing of the Andes that led to South America’s liberation from Spanish colonization, a group of engineers and Andean muleteers embark on an expedition across the mountains to liberate a robot.

results.title: Second Season
results.overview: A few years ago, Paula Ferrara wrote “The Pussy and the Razor.” Its success turned her into “the voice of her generation.” Today, Paula is a failed writer—a ghostwriter who earns a living churning out books for mediocre influencers. Her latest, desperate assignment is to pen the biography of Lil Rogelio, a fading trap music legend fresh out of prison who is supposedly seeking redemption. But are Paula and Lil Rogelio truly prepared for this second season?

results.title: Dead Bee Sting
results.overview: The story follows a tragic sequence of events that begins when Yusuf, a successful lawyer, loses his infant child due to a mistake. In the aftermath, Yusuf experiences an internal collapse, burdened by profound remorse and guilt, while his wife, Ayşe, falls into a deep depression—pushing their marriage to the brink of a major crisis. The film explores the weight of conscience by drawing a metaphorical parallel between the tragic fate of the deceased infant and a "dead bee," which serves as a symbol for lost innocence and inner suffering. Centered on themes of tragedy, loss, and guilt, the narrative unfolds as a journey of internal transformation; the characters must confront their own inner worlds, seek to forgive one another, and attempt to rebuild their lives in the wake of their pain, ultimately searching for the possibility of absolution.

results.title: GW:s mord - Familjetragedin i Svartöstaden
results.overview: The morning calm in Svartöstaden is brutally shattered by a blood-curdling roar. A mother and son are found dead. In the yard, a 19-year-old is apprehended, barefoot in the snow.
